data:
**NVIDIA earned far more: about $72.9 billion against roughly $3.8 billion for Tesla, or about 19 times as much.**

NVIDIA reported GAAP net income of about $72.9 billion for fiscal 2025, the year that ended January 26, 2025. That was up from $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024.

Tesla's fiscal year is the calendar year. Its GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders for fiscal 2025 was roughly $3.8 billion, based on my recollection of its quarterly results (about $0.4 billion, $1.2 billion, $1.4 billion and $0.8 billion). That was down from about $7.1 billion in 2024.

The two years do not line up. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 mostly covers calendar 2024, while Tesla's covers calendar 2025. If you compare the same calendar period instead, NVIDIA's fiscal 2026 net income was well over $100 billion, which would make the gap closer to 30 times.

I recalled these figures rather than checking them against the 10-K filings. Please verify them, especially Tesla's fourth-quarter number, before relying on them.
